json_schema.description: Internal port response for CategoryLookupPort (consumed by expense-service, budget-service).
Payment method options (REQ-EXP-001 / contract §4.1).
T054 — Create expense request DTO. amount>0 validated in ExpenseService (IllegalArgumentException→400).
T054/T055 — Expense response DTO (AL-4: entity never serialized directly).
T056 — Update expense request DTO. When savingsGoalId is set, service enforces EXP-INV-5 (categoryId must be Savings Category).
T124 — income-service's OWN Recurrence Pattern value object (AL-3). Duplicated from the Recurring Expense pattern — deliberately NOT shared via shared-kernel.

Create/Edit Income request (contract §7 DTOs). {@code source} is the named origin of the Income (glossary "Source" — never "payer"/"origin"/"from"). {@code recurrence} is optional — present ⇒ recurring Income (spawns a RecurringIncome template).
Income representation (AL-4 — controllers expose this DTO, never the entity). {@code recurringIncomeId} is non-null on generated Occurrences.
Presence of this block on an {@link IncomeRequest} marks the Income recurring and spawns a RecurringIncome template. At most one of endDate / maxOccurrences (RecurrenceBound); neither ⇒ indefinite.
RecurringIncome template representation (AL-4 — DTO only).
Client-facing Notification type enum (Doc 09 §9.1). The four canonical types surfaced in the Notification Center. Transactional emails (verify/reset) do NOT create a Notification row.
Count of Notifications transitioned unread → read (contract §DTOs).
Notification Center read-model DTO (contract §DTOs). AL-4: entities never serialized. {@code body} carries no PII/amounts (CQ-13); {@code readAt} is null until marked read.
Current unread count for the Notification Center badge (contract §DTOs).
Dashboard read-model (contract §DTOs, REQ-DASH-001…006, REQ-GOAL-014). AL-4: DTO only. {@code categoryName} is null — reporting cannot resolve names without a cross-schema lookup (AL-1).
Report read-model (contract §DTOs; REQ-RPT-001…004). AL-4: DTO only. {@code categoryName} is null — names require a cross-schema lookup that AL-1 prohibits.
Uniform error envelope — API-3. Serializes exactly: timestamp, status, error, message, path, traceId. The {@code message} field MUST carry zero PII (CQ-13).
Uniform pagination envelope — API-2. Serializes exactly: content, page, size, totalElements, totalPages.

operations.description_hint: Streams the artefact SYNCHRONOUSLY to the servlet output stream (row-by-row, bounded memory — CQ-10). Validation (scope/format/range) runs BEFORE any byte is written, so bad input still yields a clean 400 with no partial body. Synchronous streaming keeps the JWT-authenticated security context intact (no async re-dispatch).
